fermions.description: Standard fermionic CAR pair; a_1_p = a_1^+, a_1_m = a_1^-

bosonic_commutators.description: Canonical commutation relations for bosonic oscillators

K.description: Even central identity element; K = 1 in all current applications
K.note: Not an independent basis element; excluded from PBW ordering

basis.ordering_convention: PBW Option A: [odd] < [even]; within odd: positive ε-block (pp/pm by k) then negative ε-block (mp/mm by k); within even: Cartans H_1...H_{n+1}, then positive roots by height, then negative, then mixed

H_1.note: First Cartan; includes fermionic number operator a_1^+ a_1^-

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
